content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Hosted marketplaces like Gumroad or Paddle promise simplicity but revoke access based on your location. Crypto payment gateways like NOWPayments or Coinbase Commerce let you accept payments but leave hosting, delivery, and order management to you. Self-hosted stacks combine free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase into a unified system you own. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, configured for automatic crypto payment verification and instant file delivery. Hosted marketplaces offer zero sovereignty. Crypto gateways solve one problem but create three more. Self-hosted stacks provide full ownership and automation—no platform dependence, no subscriptions, no geographic restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Hosted marketplaces exclude Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other regions outright. Their terms of service explicitly prohibit accounts from these countries. Crypto payment gateways like NOWPayments are location-agnostic but require you to solve hosting and delivery separately. Self-hosted stacks bypass geographic restrictions entirely because they use globally accessible tools like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration to ensure order confirmations reach customers in restricted regions. Hosted marketplaces are non-starters. Crypto gateways work but demand technical integration. Self-hosted stacks provide permanent geographic sovereignty.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Hosted marketplaces charge 5–10% per transaction and hold funds for days. Crypto gateways like NOWPayments charge 0.5% and settle payments on-chain within minutes. Self-hosted stacks using NOWPayments inherit this speed and fee structure but add no additional costs. The Edge Commerce Stack includes NOWPayments integration, so payments confirm automatically and trigger instant file delivery. Hosted marketplaces are slow and expensive. Crypto gateways are fast and cheap but require manual setup. Self-hosted stacks deliver the best payment economics with full automation.
Hosted marketplaces exclude you by default—self-hosted stacks don’t.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Hosted marketplaces own your customer data, payment history, and product files. Crypto gateways let you own payments but leave you managing hosting and delivery manually. Self-hosted stacks give you full ownership of everything—data, payments, files, and infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack automates order processing, payment verification, and file delivery using Cloudflare Workers and Google Drive. Hosted marketplaces rent you access. Crypto gateways solve one problem. Self-hosted stacks give you permanent infrastructure sovereignty.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a restricted country, hosted marketplaces are not an option. If you want fast, low-fee payments but can manage technical setup, crypto gateways work. If you want a complete, automated system you own outright, self-hosted stacks are the only choice. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this architecture in 48 hours, configured for your products and region. Hosted marketplaces fail. Crypto gateways require work. Self-hosted stacks provide permanent, sovereign commerce infrastructure.

Self-hosted stacks using tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments provide the best solution for selling software without Stripe. They bypass geographic restrictions, offer fast crypto payments with 0.5% fees, and automate file delivery. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this architecture in 48 hours, giving you full ownership and sovereignty.
Crypto payment gateways solve one problem—self-hosted stacks solve all of them.

It includes Cloudflare Pages hosting, Cloudflare Workers backend logic, Supabase order storage, and NOWPayments integration. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose a hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (free). 2. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script (free). 3. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets (free). 4. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery (free). 5. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification (0.5% fee). 6. Deploy the Edge Commerce Stack for a fully configured system in 48 hours.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use Stripe or PayPal with self-hosted stacks?
No. Self-hosted stacks bypass Stripe and PayPal entirely by using crypto payment gateways like NOWPayments. This eliminates geographic restrictions and platform dependence.
How do I handle chargebacks with crypto payments?
Crypto transactions are irreversible, so chargebacks are not possible. This reduces fraud risk but requires clear product descriptions and customer communication.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept for low fees?
Use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks—transaction fees are under $0.10. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, but these networks offer the best economics.
Do I need technical skills to deploy a self-hosted stack?
Basic technical skills are required, but the Edge Commerce Stack includes full deployment and 30-day support. The architecture is designed for digital creators, not developers.
What happens after deployment?
You own everything outright. COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure. No subscriptions, no platform dependence, lifetime access.
